prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1434; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained significant injuries as a result of the other vehicle entering the intersection and striking the driver's side of our client's car. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you provide the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim and the claim number so that we may coordinate.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, recorded statements, police and accident reports, vehicle inspection records, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that all such materials are retained and not altered, repaired, or discarded pending resolution of this claim.
